import pandas as pd
from phase1_pipeline import build_feature_matrix, StrToComposition, ElementFraction

result = build_feature_matrix(dummy_df, formula_col='formula_pretty')
print('Result shape:', result.shape)
print('Columns:', len(result.columns))
cols = list(result.columns)
feature_cols = [c for c in cols if c != 'formula_pretty']
print('Feature columns count:', len(feature_cols))
print('Sample feature names:', feature_cols[:8])
print('Flattened numerical feature vector verified.')
